phone calls and appointments.pt: Tudo bem se eu te ligar depois? Agora estou dirigindo e não posso falar.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si no me equivoco, quedamos en vernos a las cinco en la puerta de la notaría, ¿verdad?
phone calls and appointments.en: If I'm not mistaken, we arranged to meet at five outside the notary's office, didn't we?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se não me engano, combinamos de nos encontrar às cinco na porta do cartório, certo?

phone calls and appointments.text: Disculpe, creo que se ha equivocado de número; aquí no vive nadie con ese nombre.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I think you've got the wrong number; nobody by that name lives here.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, acho que o senhor ligou para o número errado; aqui não mora ninguém com esse nome.

phone calls and appointments.text: La recepcionista me dijo que me devolverían la llamada en el transcurso de la mañana, pero nada.
phone calls and appointments.en: The receptionist told me they'd call me back during the morning, but nothing.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A recepcionista me disse que retornariam a ligação no decorrer da manhã, mas nada.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le paso con mi compañera, que es quien lleva su expediente y podrá resolverle la duda.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll put you through to my colleague, who's handling your file and will be able to answer your question.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou transferir o senhor para a minha colega, que é quem cuida do seu processo e vai poder tirar a sua dúvida.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Sería tan amable de deletrearme su apellido para que no haya errores en la reserva?
phone calls and appointments.en: Would you be so kind as to spell your surname for me so there are no mistakes in the booking?
phone calls and appointments.pt: O senhor poderia soletrar o seu sobrenome para que não haja erros na reserva?

phone calls and appointments.text: Se oye fatal, ¿me oyes? Creo que me estoy quedando sin batería; luego te llamo.
phone calls and appointments.en: The line's terrible, can you hear me? I think my battery's running out; I'll call you later.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Está péssimo o som, você está me ouvindo? Acho que a bateria está acabando; depois te ligo.

phone calls and appointments.text: Necesitaría cambiar la hora de la revisión del coche, porque coincide con una reunión de trabajo.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd need to change the time of the car service, because it clashes with a work meeting.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu precisaria mudar o horário da revisão do carro, porque coincide com uma reunião de trabalho.

phone calls and appointments.text: Me han dado cita para renovar el DNI dentro de tres semanas, que ya es decir.
phone calls and appointments.en: They've given me an appointment to renew my ID card in three weeks' time, which says it all.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Me deram horário para renovar a carteira de identidade daqui a três semanas, o que já diz tudo.

phone calls and appointments.text: En cuanto sepas algo de los resultados, llámame, aunque sea tarde, que no voy a pegar ojo.
phone calls and appointments.en: As soon as you hear anything about the results, call me, even if it is late, because I will not sleep a wink.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Assim que você souber alguma coisa dos resultados, me liga, mesmo que seja tarde, que eu não vou pregar o olho.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si quiere, le puedo apuntar en lista de espera por si alguien cancela su cita.
phone calls and appointments.en: If you like, I can put you on the waiting list in case someone cancels their appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se quiser, posso colocar o senhor na lista de espera caso alguém cancele o horário.

phone calls and appointments.text: Llamé a la peluquería para reservar, pero no tenían hueco hasta el sábado por la tarde.
phone calls and appointments.en: I rang the hairdresser's to book, but they didn't have a slot until Saturday afternoon.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Liguei para o salão para marcar, mas não tinha horário até sábado à tarde.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Con quién tengo el gusto de hablar? Es para dejar constancia de esta llamada.
phone calls and appointments.en: Who do I have the pleasure of speaking to? It's so we can keep a record of this call.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Com quem tenho o prazer de falar? É para deixar registrada esta ligação.

phone calls and appointments.text: Te dejé un mensaje en el contestador, pero como no me contestabas empecé a preocuparme.
phone calls and appointments.en: I left you a message on your voicemail, but since you didn't reply I started to worry.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Deixei uma mensagem na sua caixa postal, mas como você não respondia comecei a ficar preocupado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Buenas tardes, llamo de parte de la señora Ruiz para confirmar la entrevista del lunes.
phone calls and appointments.en: Good afternoon, I'm calling on behalf of Mrs Ruiz to confirm Monday's interview.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Boa tarde, estou ligando da parte da senhora Ruiz para confirmar a entrevista de segunda.

phone calls and appointments.text: Siento no haberte cogido el teléfono; estaba en el cine y lo tenía en silencio.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry I didn't pick up; I was at the cinema and had my phone on silent.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe não ter atendido; eu estava no cinema e o celular estava no silencioso.

phone calls and appointments.text: Para cualquier gestión, le recomiendo que pida cita previa a través de la página web.
phone calls and appointments.en: For any procedure, I'd recommend booking an appointment in advance through the website.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Para qualquer serviço, recomendo que o senhor agende o atendimento pelo site.

phone calls and appointments.text: Me han pedido que llegue un cuarto de hora antes para rellenar unos formularios.
phone calls and appointments.en: They've asked me to arrive a quarter of an hour early to fill in some forms.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Me pediram para chegar quinze minutos antes para preencher uns formulários.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Podríamos adelantar la reunión a las once? Me ha surgido un compromiso a mediodía.
phone calls and appointments.en: Could we bring the meeting forward to eleven? Something has come up at midday.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Poderíamos antecipar a reunião para as onze? Surgiu um compromisso para o meio-dia.

phone calls and appointments.text: Por favor, en cuanto llegue el técnico, dígale que me llame antes de subir al piso.
phone calls and appointments.en: Please, as soon as the technician arrives, tell him to call me before going up to the flat.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Por favor, assim que o técnico chegar, peça para ele me ligar antes de subir ao apartamento.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mi madre se pasa horas al teléfono con su hermana, aunque viven en la misma calle.
phone calls and appointments.en: My mother spends hours on the phone with her sister, even though they live on the same street.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Minha mãe passa horas no telefone com a irmã, embora as duas morem na mesma rua.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le confirmo que su cita queda registrada para el día doce a las cuatro y media.
phone calls and appointments.en: I can confirm that your appointment is booked for the twelfth at half past four.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Confirmo que a sua consulta está marcada para o dia doze às quatro e meia.

phone calls and appointments.text: Como no localizaba a Nacho, le escribí un correo para no tener que seguir insistiendo.
phone calls and appointments.en: Since I couldn't get hold of Nacho, I sent him an email so I wouldn't have to keep trying.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Como eu não conseguia falar com o Nacho, mandei um e-mail para não ter que ficar insistindo.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le llamaba porque me ha llegado una carta suya y no sé muy bien qué documentación tengo que aportar.
phone calls and appointments.en: I was calling because I've received a letter from you and I'm not quite sure what documents I need to provide.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu estava ligando porque recebi uma carta de vocês e não sei bem que documentação preciso apresentar.

phone calls and appointments.text: Llevo toda la mañana intentando hablar con el seguro, pero comunica constantemente.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've been trying to get through to the insurance company all morning, but the line is constantly engaged.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Passei a manhã inteira tentando falar com a seguradora, mas só dá ocupado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si hubiera sabido que la consulta estaba cerrada por las tardes, habría pedido la cita por la mañana.
phone calls and appointments.en: If I'd known the surgery was closed in the afternoons, I'd have booked a morning appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se eu soubesse que o consultório ficava fechado à tarde, teria marcado a consulta de manhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Te importa que hablemos por videollamada? Así puedo enseñarte los planos de la casa.
phone calls and appointments.en: Do you mind if we talk by video call? That way I can show you the plans of the house.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você se importa se a gente falar por videochamada? Assim posso te mostrar a planta da casa.

phone calls and appointments.text: Disculpe la espera, ya tengo su ficha delante; ¿en qué puedo ayudarle?
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry to keep you waiting, I have your file in front of me now; how can I help you?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe a espera, já estou com a sua ficha aqui na frente; em que posso ajudar?

phone calls and appointments.text: Te cuelgo, que me está entrando otra llamada; hablamos luego con más calma.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm going to hang up, I've got another call coming in; we'll talk properly later.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou desligar, que está entrando outra ligação; depois a gente conversa com mais calma.
